title: Tadasana Ka Jhol Jhal!
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, a glossy cute character with big expressive eyes and a small headband, hyper-detailed macro close-up, cinematic soft lighting, rich colours, vertical 9:16

Tadasana Bhai.look: A tall, majestic cartoon figure resembling a stylized green-brown mountain, with a saffron yogi headband. Confident, smiling face.

Peeth Bhai.look: A friendly, slightly curvy cartoon spine, creamy white, with visible segments. Initially a bit slouched, then straightens up. Has a cheerful but sometimes worried expression.

scenes.image: [[Tadasana Bhai]] stands tall and proud, arms raised high, smiling widely.
scenes.speaker: Tadasana Bhai
scenes.line: Arre bhai, main hoon Tadasana! Seedha khada reh!
scenes.say: अरे भाई, मैं हूँ ताड़ासन! सीधा खड़ा रह!

scenes.image: [[Tadasana Bhai]] stands tall and proud, arms raised high, smiling widely.
scenes.speaker: Tadasana Bhai
scenes.line: Haan, sahi pakde hain! Poora mountain jaisa ekdum!
scenes.say: हाँ, सही पकड़े हैं! पूरा माउंटेन जैसा एकदम!

scenes.image: [[Tadasana Bhai]] stands tall and proud, arms raised high, smiling widely.
scenes.speaker: Tadasana Bhai
scenes.line: Tension nahi lene ka, posture set karne ka simple tareeka.
scenes.say: टेंशन नहीं लेने का, पोस्चर सेट करने का सिम्पल तरीका।

scenes.image: [[Peeth Bhai]] is seen slightly slouched, looking tired but friendly.
scenes.speaker: Peeth Bhai
scenes.line: Arre main hoon Peeth Bhai, teri back! Baithe baithe tedha ho gaya tha.
scenes.say: अरे मैं हूँ पीठ भाई, तेरी बैक! बैठे बैठे टेढ़ा हो गया था।

scenes.image: [[Peeth Bhai]] is seen slightly slouched, looking tired but friendly.
scenes.speaker: Peeth Bhai
scenes.line: Poora din screen pe, shoulder aage, gardan neeche.
scenes.say: पूरा दिन स्क्रीन पे, शोल्डर आगे, गर्दन नीचे।

scenes.image: [[Peeth Bhai]] is seen slightly slouched, looking tired but friendly.
scenes.speaker: Peeth Bhai
scenes.line: Bhidu, bahut lafda ho raha tha body mein.
scenes.say: भिड़ू, बहुत लफड़ा हो रहा था बॉडी में।

scenes.image: [[Tadasana Bhai]] demonstrates the pose perfectly, looking encouraging.
scenes.speaker: Tadasana Bhai
scenes.line: Dekh, Tadasana bole toh, pair jod, haath upar utha.
scenes.say: देख, ताड़ासन बोले तो, पैर जोड़, हाथ ऊपर उठा।

scenes.image: [[Tadasana Bhai]] demonstrates the pose perfectly, looking encouraging.
scenes.speaker: Tadasana Bhai
scenes.line: Ekdum dheere se upar stretch kar, jaisa tree.
scenes.say: एकदम धीरे से ऊपर स्ट्रेच कर, जैसा ट्री।

scenes.image: [[Tadasana Bhai]] demonstrates the pose perfectly, looking encouraging.
scenes.speaker: Tadasana Bhai
scenes.line: Body ko seedha kar, saans andar-bahar. Bas!
scenes.say: बॉडी को सीधा कर, साँस अंदर-बाहर। बस!

scenes.image: [[Peeth Bhai]] is now noticeably straighter, smiling happily, stretching a bit.
scenes.speaker: Peeth Bhai
scenes.line: Oho! Jabse Tadasana kiya, main ekdum fit lagta hoon.
scenes.say: ओहो! जबसे ताड़ासन किया, मैं एकदम फिट लगता हूँ।

scenes.image: [[Peeth Bhai]] is now noticeably straighter, smiling happily, stretching a bit.
scenes.speaker: Peeth Bhai
scenes.line: Pehle jhuka hua tha, abhi height bhi badhi hui lagti hai.
scenes.say: पहले झुका हुआ था, अभी हाइट भी बढ़ी हुई लगती है।

scenes.image: [[Peeth Bhai]] is now noticeably straighter, smiling happily, stretching a bit.
scenes.speaker: Peeth Bhai
scenes.line: Mast posture ho gaya, tension gayab! Ekdum fresh feel hota hai.
scenes.say: मस्त पोस्चर हो गया, टेंशन गायब! एकदम फ्रेश फील होता है।

scenes.image: [[Tadasana Bhai]] is in a relaxed, teaching pose, still tall and confident.
scenes.speaker: Tadasana Bhai
scenes.line: Yeh beginner ke liye ekdum mast stretch hai.
scenes.say: यह बिगिनर के लिए एकदम मस्त स्ट्रेच है।

scenes.image: [[Tadasana Bhai]] is in a relaxed, teaching pose, still tall and confident.
scenes.speaker: Tadasana Bhai
scenes.line: Har subah ya shaam kar, body khulegi.
scenes.say: हर सुबह या शाम कर, बॉडी खुलेगी।

scenes.image: [[Tadasana Bhai]] is in a relaxed, teaching pose, still tall and confident.
scenes.speaker: Tadasana Bhai
scenes.line: Lekin zyada zor nahi lagane ka, aaram se karne ka.
scenes.say: लेकिन ज़्यादा ज़ोर नहीं लगाने का, आराम से करने का।

scenes.image: [[Tadasana Bhai]] looks at the viewer directly, with a friendly, wise expression.
scenes.speaker: Tadasana Bhai
scenes.line: Agar koi health ka lafda hai, toh pehle doctor ko milne ka.
scenes.say: अगर कोई हेल्थ का लफड़ा है, तो पहले डॉक्टर को मिलने का।

scenes.image: [[Tadasana Bhai]] looks at the viewer directly, with a friendly, wise expression.
scenes.speaker: Tadasana Bhai
scenes.line: Koi bhi yoga ho, sahi tareeke se karna important hai.
scenes.say: कोई भी योग हो, सही तरीके से करना इम्पोर्टेन्ट है।

scenes.image: [[Tadasana Bhai]] looks at the viewer directly, with a friendly, wise expression.
scenes.speaker: Tadasana Bhai
scenes.line: Bole toh, aap kitni baar body ko stretch karte ho?
scenes.say: बोले तो, आप कितनी बार बॉडी को स्ट्रेच करते हो?
